_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Temporary Access Cut Drawing/Sketch
summary: This DID identifies each proposed access cut to the ship structure and engine enclosure and lists each proposed bolted/riveted access removal not on NAVSEA-approved drawings.
use_relationship:
This DID will identify each proposed access cut to the ship structure and engine enclosure and a list of each proposed bolted/riveted access removal. The drawing/sketch shall not contain authorized access cuts on NAVSEA-approved drawings.
This DID contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract.
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: References.
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as specified in the contract.

preparation_instructions.title: Format.
preparation_instructions.content: The Drawing/Sketch shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content.
preparation_instructions.content: The Drawing/Sketch shall include the following information:

children.title: A plan and elevation view specifying the location of the access by deck, frame, and distance from the center line or deck edge and showing location of adjacent penetrations, bulkheads, framing, welds, and riveted joints within 12 inches of the proposed cut.
Location and number of previous cuts visible in each plate and the cutback of existing welds.
Temporary structural reinforcement required to prevent distortion of ship structure.
Thickness and type of material of plating and structural members to be cut.
children.content: Include source or document/drawing number which identifies material requirements.

children.title: A description of the temporary access closure and enclosures.
A copy of the weld approved weld procedure number with the proposed access sketch.
List of bolted/riveted access covers shall include location, designation, and classification as identified on ship's damage control book.
All drawing titles and numbers (including applicable sub-tier), and technical documentation that will used to accomplish the requirements of MIL-STD-1689.
